{{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Hallow Guard''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Blind Faith]] as part of the [[Null & Void Event]]. It had a decent amount of health and an above average speed. ==Appearance== The '''Hallow Guard''' is made entirely of white parts that resemble a skeletal humanoid. It does not have a full torso, but instead has the bone cage for it. Its head is slightly smaller than most other enemies and has two large flaming blue eyeholes. It wears a brown belt, grey shoulder-pads, crown and a chestplate, which as a black skull with neon blue eyes on it. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Blind Faith]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]], [[Ranger]] or [[Pursuit]] are recommended here. **As it occasionally spawns as a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy, towers with hidden detection or with it applied to them through other towers or modifiers are especially useful. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be used to boost the statistics of your towers. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} HallowGuardWalk.gif|Walking animation (31 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseHallowGuard.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (31 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} OldMortarThumbnail.png|'''Hallow Guard''' on the game thumbnial. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ModernHallowGuardIconIG.png|'''Hallow Guard''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Update History== *'''31 October 2025''' - [[v1.79.0]] **'''Hallow Guard''' added. **{{Bug}} Default [[Shield Health]] of 7,000 is never applied, it only has [[Shield Health]] in modes with specific values set for them. *'''26 November 2025''' - [[v1.80.0|v1.80.1e]] **'''Hallow Guard''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''20 December 2025''' - [[v1.83.0]] **{{Bugfix}} Now has a default [[Shield Health]] value of 7,000. {{BlindFaith|[[Null Accelerator]]|Wave 25|[[Skeleton]], [[Executioner Skeleton (Null & Void)|Executioner Skeleton]], [[Giant Skeleton]], Hallow Guard & [[Null Necromancer]]|Wave 27|[[Rift Walker]]|Wave 30}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Hallow Guard}} [[Category:Null & Void Event]] [[Category:Blind Faith]]
